{
  "title": "Hello and How Are You? Pair Interview",
  "grade": "primary_1",
  "cefr": "Pre-A1",
  "skill": "speaking",
  "topic": "greetings_and_introductions",
  "language_function": "greetings_leave_taking",
  "activity_type": "pair_interview",
  "duration_minutes": 10,
  "learning_objective": "Students can greet peers, ask how they are, and respond using simple learned phrases.",
  "student_instructions": "Work with your partner. Take turns to say hello, ask 'How are you?', and answer 'I am fine, thank you. And you?'. Finish with a friendly goodbye!",
  "teacher_instructions": "Organize students into pairs. Guide them through the model phrases before letting them practice together. Monitor pairs for pronunciation and polite social interaction.",
  "language_support": {
    "useful_phrases": [
      "How are you?",
      "I am fine, thank you. And you?",
      "Hello Song",
      "Goodbye Song"
    ],
    "grammar_support": [
      "Verb Be in the Present Simple - Identity and State",
      "Classroom Imperatives and Action Directives"
    ],
    "vocabulary_support": [
      "greetings_and_introductions",
      "Hello",
      "Goodbye",
      "Thank you"
    ]
  },
  "activity_steps": [
    {
      "phase": "warm_up",
      "duration_minutes": 2,
      "teacher_instructions": "Sing a short 'Hello Song' together with the whole class to activate target expressions and establish a welcoming environment.",
      "student_instructions": "Listen to the teacher and sing along with the 'Hello Song' to greet your classmates."
    },
    {
      "phase": "core_task",
      "duration_minutes": 6,
      "teacher_instructions": "Model the dialogue with a student volunteer first. Then instruct pairs to face each other and conduct the interview using the useful phrases.",
      "student_instructions": "Turn to your partner. Say 'Hello', ask 'How are you?', listen to the answer, and reply back using the model phrases."
    },
    {
      "phase": "wrap_up",
      "duration_minutes": 2,
      "teacher_instructions": "Praise student participation and lead the class in singing a closing 'Goodbye Song' to model leave-taking.",
      "student_instructions": "Wave to your partner and sing the 'Goodbye Song' to finish the activity."
    }
  ],
  "assessment": {
    "criteria": [
      "Task Achievement: Successfully greets and responds to the partner.",
      "Fluency: Speaks with minimal hesitation using the provided model expressions.",
      "Range: Uses basic social interaction repertoire appropriately.",
      "Accuracy: Pronounces key phrases ('How are you?', 'I am fine') clearly."
    ],
    "rubric_snapshot": [
      "Exceeds Expectations: Uses greetings and responses autonomously with correct pronunciation.",
      "Meets Expectations: Uses greetings and responses with minor teacher prompting.",
      "Below Expectations: Struggles to produce basic greeting phrases without heavy support."
    ]
  }
}
